ebpf_tracepoint_connect.namespace_note: PIDs are from the sensor's PID namespace, not the workload's -- see the ground truth pid

state_transitions.note: family 2 = AF_INET, 10 = AF_INET6. The established count is the only source that knows a connection succeeded; the connect() return value does not.

proc_net_tcp_poll.caveat: most sightings are TIME_WAIT -- the residue of a connection that already closed, not an observation of it happening. The capture rate here flatters polling badly.
proc_net_tcp_poll.note: a socket seen in /proc/net/tcp carries an inode, not a process; attribution needs a second scan of /proc/*/fd, which is slower again and races the same way

decision_inputs.ebpf_cost: a compiler and BTF at build time, or bpftrace (~100 MB with LLVM) at runtime; output parsed from text in the bpftrace case, which is fragile
decision_inputs.ebpf_unique_advantage: reads task_struct->start_boottime in-kernel, measured at 53304640255814 ns against a ground truth of 5330464 ticks at 100 Hz -- a match to 0.26 ms. This solves PID reuse and the process-exit race at source.
decision_inputs.namespace_finding: the sensor observes PIDs in its own namespace. The workload was PID 20 in its container and PID 84658 to the sensor. Attribution that ignores this is confidently wrong.
decision_inputs.proc_poll_verdict: rejected on evidence: 1 ESTABLISHED sighting against 44389 TIME_WAIT sightings. Its 93.8 percent capture rate counts the residue of connections that already closed, and it cannot attribute a socket to a process at all.

cannot_do.in_kernel_process_start_time: task_struct->start_boottime is not a tracepoint field, so process-instance identity must be bound by correlation rather than captured at source

measured.dependencies: none: no eBPF, no compiler, no libbpf, no BCC
measured.loss_accounting: per_cpu/cpuN/stats reports overrun, commit overrun and dropped events -- loss is visible rather than inferred
measured.private_buffer: creating /sys/kernel/tracing/instances/<name> gives a buffer no other tool shares, so Annulon cannot be starved or corrupted by another tracer
measured.softirq_flag_observed: ..s1. on the ESTABLISHED transition, so the process context there is not reliable in general -- it matched only because this was loopback
